## Claims about sources

- [ ] **Citation check.** For every claim this PR makes about what a source says or contains, I opened the cited version of the source, found the section, table, figure or file line, and confirmed it says this. Values we derived are marked *our arithmetic* and show their inputs. (Checking against another chapter of this book, or a secondary source, does not count. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#claims-about-sources-fact-sheets-and-the-citation-check).)
- [ ] Facts about a specific model are linked to its [fact sheet](../book/appendix/c-fact-sheets.md) row, not restated.
- [ ] Every config block is **real** (generated by `tools/build_configs.py`) or labelled **illustrative**.
- [ ] If this fixes a claim that was wrong when written, it has an entry on the [errata page](../book/appendix/d-errata.md). If it updates a claim the field has since overtaken, it goes in the CHANGELOG and the chapter's currency stamp moves.
- [ ] Every number a lab prints, or that the text quotes from a lab, comes from a full-size run and is computed rather than typed.

## Checks

- [ ] `python3 tools/check_links.py`
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p "test_*.py"`
- [ ] `python3 tools/check_structure.py`
- [ ] `python3 tools/build_configs.py --check`
- [ ] `python3 tools/build_notebooks.py --check`
- [ ] `python3 tools/run_labs.py` (or the labs this touches)
